name: application-retry-error-state
title: Retry Error State
description: Inline failure panels for data that failed to load, pairing a cause message with a retry action, at both full-panel and compact widget scale.
useWhen: A fetch, mutation, or data load has failed and the user needs a clear way to retry it.
Replacing a section or widget's content with a failure state after an unsuccessful request, rather than showing stale or broken content.
The failure is scoped to one section of the page — other content and navigation should remain usable.
avoidWhen: There is no data yet because none has been created — use an empty state instead, since there's nothing to retry.
The failure is fatal and affects the entire page or route — use a full error page instead.
The error is a validation problem on a form field — use inline field validation instead.
responsiveBehavior: The full panel centers its content and constrains message width (max-w-xs) so it reads well at any container size; the compact variant is a single-row flex layout that wraps naturally in narrow cards.
accessibility: Both variants use role="alert" so the failure is announced to screen readers as soon as it renders.
The retry button is a real <button>, keyboard-operable and independently focusable from any surrounding content.
The compact variant surfaces the underlying cause (e.g. an HTTP status) as secondary text, giving users and support agents concrete diagnostic detail without cluttering the primary message.

variants.title: Full panel
variants.description: Centered failure panel with icon, message, and a primary retry button, for a section or full dashboard load failure
accessibility: role="alert" on the panel ensures the failure is announced without requiring the user to discover it visually.

variants.title: Full panel (Dark)
variants.description: Centered failure panel with icon, message, and a primary retry button, for a section or full dashboard load failure
accessibility: Colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.

variants.title: Compact inline
variants.description: Single-row failure banner with a cause message and a trailing retry action, for a smaller widget or card that failed to load
accessibility: The HTTP status text gives assistive-tech users the same diagnostic detail sighted users see.

variants.title: Compact inline (Dark)
variants.description: Single-row failure banner with a cause message and a trailing retry action, for a smaller widget or card that failed to load
accessibility: Colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
